notes: Direct HTTP fetch throughout (Tier 1), no WAF. Two distinct 'nieuw binnen' URLs exist: /pages/nieuw-binnen is an EDITORIAL HUB page (<title>Ontdek de nieuwste producten bij fonQ</title>) with no product-overview widget / no nbResults -- it only contains navigation tiles linking to the 6 department pages plus a small 'Iets voor jou?' recommendation carousel; excluded as a landing/marketing page per the brief's Collection-page test. Its product-listing counterpart /collections/nieuw-binnen DOES have a real product grid and nbResults widget and was used instead as the parent row. Discovery method: main nav mega-menu (all department headers carry a 'Nieuwe collectie'/'Nieuw in X' link), the site's XML sitemap index, and a site /sitemap human-readable page (2419 links, cross-checked) which additionally surfaced two department children (Baby & Kids, Huishouden) not present in the homepage mega-menu HTML actually fetched, plus confirmed no Bathroom 'new' page exists (nieuw-in-badkamer -> 404). IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY FINDING, applies broadly: cross-referenced every 'new' listing's own nbResults against its full parent department's own nbResults (fetched independently) and found systematic inconsistency -- 2 of 7 non-zero children (Garden & Balcony, Sleep) report a count IDENTICAL to their full department total, and 3 more (Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Home Accessories) report a count that EXCEEDS their full department total. A 'new' subset cannot legitimately be equal to or larger than its own parent department if it is genuinely time-bounded -- this indicates fonQ's 'Nieuw'/'Nieuw in' collections do not reliably filter to recently-added items on this site (possibly a default sort=newest applied without an actual recency cutoff, or a broader underlying index scope than the stated department). Each affected row is flagged individually with the specific comparison. Only Furniture and Household children showed a plausible bounded-subset ratio (75% and 21% of their department respectively) and were left unflagged. Also found and EXCLUDED as brand/product-line campaign pages (not general site New Arrivals structure): brabantia-nieuw, hay-nieuw, hk-living-nieuw, nieuw-van-dutchbone, nieuw-van-zuiver, by-fonq-nieuw, k-amsterdam-nieuwe-collectie, k-amsterdam-ss26-nieuwe-collectie, dekbedovertrekken-nieuwe-collectie, hay-nieuwe-tuincollectie, merken/lekue/nieuw -- all are single-brand or single-product-line 'new' pages, not the site's general New Arrivals merchandising concept. Dropped as zero-product: nieuw-in-baby-kids (0 artikelen).
